rules.source_span: An employee who relocates their primary residence more than 50 miles closer to their assigned work site is entitled to the relocation bonus.
Override: The relocation bonus does not apply when the destination residence is a property the employee (or their spouse) already owned at the time the role was offered.

prose.reasoning: Dana relocated 120 miles (exceeding the 50-mile threshold), but Section 2 override disqualifies her: the destination lakeside house was already personally owned since 2019, before the role was offered.
Section 2 override applies: destination was already owned (inherited condo held 6 years), which excludes the bonus regardless of the 75-mile distance meeting Section 1's 50-mile threshold.

Priya meets Section 1's distance criterion (210 miles > 50 miles), but Section 2 override disqualifies her: the destination residence was already jointly owned by Priya and her spouse when the role was offered. The override applies regardless of distance.

Lou relocated 95 miles (exceeds 50 mi threshold), but Section 2 override disqualifies him: destination cabin was purchased in 2017, already owned when role was offered. Override beats distance rule regardless of miles.

Ben relocated 60 miles (exceeds 50-mile threshold under Section 1) but into a duplex he already owned. Section 2 explicitly overrides Section 1: the bonus does not apply when the destination is already-owned property, regardless of distance.

Sofia's relocation (80 mi) exceeds the 50-mile threshold in Section 1, but Section 2's override applies: she already owned the destination property at the time the role was offered. The override beats the distance rule.
